dispatches.message: STRATEGIC UPDATE Miscalibrations in the Democracy Space Station have required it to be taken temporarily offline in order to be resolved. The Ministry of Defense has shifted significant personnel to these fixes, making it a top priority. Those responsible for the mistakes will attend an intensive re-training seminar. If the issue persists, their families will also attend the seminar.

CAMPAIGN FAILURE Cyborg interference has raised significant doubts in the veracity of the Quarter-Term Elections. As a result, a re-vote has been ordered, with enhanced election security measures to make interference impossible. SEAF Battalions have been recalled from the frontlines to secure voting sites.

NEW MAJOR ORDER The Super Earth Government, informed by the results of an expert election security panel, has passed a comprehensive Super Secure Elections Act, which allocates new military spending for upholding election security. Helldiver arsenals have been augmented with a number of stratagems. They are directed to uphold election security—by any means necessary.

MAJOR ORDER WON The Helldivers rapidly and violently decomissioned over 200,000,000 Automaton Troopers. Any ongoing production of imposter robot voters must now be redirected to refilling their frontline ranks. The upcoming Quarter-term elections have been protected from yet another external threat.

NEW MAJOR ORDER Evidence of an even more abhorrent Cyborg plot to manipulate the upcoming Quarter-term elections has been discovered: to create androids, disguised as Super Earth citizens, to infiltrate voting centers. The Helldivers are ordered to immediately deploy to destroy 200,000,000 Automaton Troopers, depleting their stock of potential infiltrators.

MAJOR ORDER FAILED The Helldivers recaptured CHARBAL-VII, by the Cyborgs retained hold of ZZANIAH PRIME. Massive server banks were discovered in the captured Megafactories. Cybersecurity specialists have confirmed that these server banks could be used in the conduct of cyberattacks—confirming the enemy's intent beyond doubt.
INCINERATION CORPS SIGHTED The Automaton Incineration Corps has resurfaced on VINDEMITARIX PRIME.
JET BRIGADE SIGHTED The Automaton Jet Brigade has resurfaced on AURORA BAY.

NEW MAJOR ORDER Intercepted Cyborg communications indicate an upcoming cyberattack designed to impede election Management for the upcoming Quarter-term elections. It is believed these assaults will originate from MegafactorIes on CHARBAL-VII and ZZANIAH PRIME. The Helldivers are ordered to liberate these planets immediately.
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION ENDED Eagle Gas Airstrike Stratagem availability has now ended.

HEETH LOST
Heeth has fallen to the Terminid Menace. We cannot allow this infestation to continue to spread.

CAMPAIGN WON TCS+ nodes are under construction on BORE ROCK and NIVEL 43 following their liberation by the Helldivers. The containment of the Terminids has never been more guaranteed. The dissident network responsible for these sabotages, which existed, has been dismantled.

HEETH UNDER ATTACK
The bugs have attacked Heeth. Rally to its defense, before they are able to permanently infest it.
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION High Command has authorized fleetwide availability of the Eagle Gas Airstrike Stratagem for the next 72 hours.

NEW MAJOR ORDER Recent sabotages of the TCS+ by dissidents have threatened the populace and inflamed public outrage. The Helldivers are ordered to liberate BORE ROCK and NIVEL 43, Terminid-held planets adjacent to those sabotaged by dissidents, so that the TCS+ can be built on those planets as well. In so doing, the impregnable barrier of the TCS+ will be made twice as impregnable as before.

MAJOR ORDER WON Deputized citizens have apprehended thousands of suspected dissidents across the Federation. They were motivated and rewarded by premium trophies of Freedom's enemies valiantly secured by the Helldivers. Hundreds of apprehended suspects have already confessed to conspiracy to sabotage the TCS+ and destroy Managed Democracy. The dissident network, which existed, is rapidly being mapped and dismantled.

MAJOR ORDER ADJUSTMENT Ongoing analysis of current major order targets has identified current targets to be overestimates. The analysts responsible for this oversight have been removed from their positions and transferred to frontline units where their evident talents will better serve Managed Democracy. The adjusted kill targets for the current Major Order are as follows: 25,000,000 Agitators, 1,000,000 Vox Engines, 50,000,000 Obtruders, and 250,000 Gatekeepers.

NEW MAJOR ORDER The dissident network responsible for the sabotage of the TCS+ has eluded justice. Predictive analytics indicate the network has dispersed domestically. High Command has ordered a Full Deputization of Super Earth citizens Class B and above. The Helldivers are ordered to secure material for the production of bounty trophies for the capture of suspected dissidents. Neutralize the high-value Illuminate and Cyborg/Automaton belligerents indicated on the Galactic Map.

MAJOR ORDER WON The Heldlivers rapidly secured each planet suspected to harbor the dissidents responsible for sabotaging the TCS+. However, no dissidents were found or apprehended. This evasion demonstrates the capability to orchestrate the rapid evacuation of dissident agents from these planets. It is clear that the dissident network is even more extensive and well-resourced than initially estimated.

STRATEGIC IMPERATIVE FAILED The Terminid outbreak remains on BRILLIANCE. Fewer than 5% of TCS+ nodes on the planet remain operational. At this time, the planet represents a severe gap in the TCS+ barrier planets, presenting risk of further outbreak and breach of containment.

NEW STRATEGIC IMPERATIVE Terminids threaten to overrun BRILLIANCE following dissident sabotage of its TCS+ towers. The Helldivers are ordered to reclaim the planet and cleanse the Terminid infestation, so that the TCS+ may be repaired.

active_campaign.title: 熾烈選戰
active_campaign.label: ACTIVE CAMPAIGN
active_campaign.description: 令人憂心的情報顯示，生化人正策劃協同行動，企圖干擾即將舉行的季度選舉。絕地戰兵受命確保本次選舉能在有效且公平的管理式民主制度下順利完成。
active_campaign.description_cn: 令人不安的情报显示，生化人正策划协同行动，意图破坏即将到来的季度选举。绝地潜兵奉命出动，确保本次选举管理高效而公正。

phases.title: 先制網路防禦
phases.briefing:
預計於兩週後舉行的季度選舉，可能正面臨威脅。攔截到的生化人通訊顯示，敵軍正策劃一場隱密的協同行動，企圖妨礙選舉管理。公平且自由的選舉管理，是聯邦立國之本，也是全體公民珍視的傳統。

真理部指出，生化人計劃發動網路攻擊，意圖竄改協助公民充分表達選舉意志的演算法。據信，這些攻擊將由位於查爾博VII和贊伊亞主星的超級工廠發起。絕地戰兵奉命立即解放這些星球。
phases.briefing_cn:
定于两周后开始的季度选举恐将陷入危机。截获的生化人通讯表明，敌方正策划一场协同的秘密行动，意图阻碍选举管理。公正而自由的选举管理是联邦的基石，也是公民珍视的传统。

真理部报告指出，生化人意图发动网络攻击，篡改那套让公民最充分表达选举意愿的算法。据信攻击将源自查巴尔 VII 与藏尼亚主星上的超大型工厂。绝地潜兵奉命立即解放这两颗星球。

phases.title: 冒牌者防範
phases.briefing:
生化人另一項更加駭人的陰謀已被發現：企圖操弄即將到來的季度選舉。證據顯示，敵軍正試圖打造擁有人類外貌，模仿人類說話方式的機器人。這些偽裝成超級地球公民的人形機器人，將企圖滲透各投票所並投下選票。

這項令人震驚且卑劣的計畫，充分證明了生化人的思想已偏離人類本源，墮落到何等地步。絕不能讓他們得逞。絕地戰兵奉命立即摧毀200,000,000名機器人新兵，耗盡敵方可用於滲透行動的潛在冒充者。
phases.briefing_cn:
已发现生化人一项更为可憎的阴谋：他们意图操纵即将到来的季度选举。现有证据表明，敌人正试图制造外观与言谈举止都酷似人类的机器人。这些仿生人将伪装成超级地球公民，渗透投票中心，投下选票。

这项计划骇人而卑劣，恰恰印证生化人的心智已从人类本源扭曲到了何种地步。绝不能让他们得逞。绝地潜兵奉命立即部署，消灭 2 亿（200,000,000）名机器人步兵，耗尽其后备渗透单位。

phases.title: 捍衛選舉
phases.briefing:
生化人層出不窮、企圖干擾季度選舉的陰謀，已嚴重打擊公民對選票管理的信心。公民必須完全相信，選舉結果能透過演算法推論，準確反映他們的真正意志，這點至關重要。

超級地球政府根據選舉安全專家小組的調查結果，正式通過《超級安全選舉法》。透過減少不必要的監督程序與參與管理式民主的人員數量，整體流程將更不容易受到敵軍干擾。此外，法案也編列新的軍事預算，以維護選舉安全。

絕地戰兵的軍械庫已新增多項戰略配備。他們奉命不惜一切代價，捍衛選舉安全。
phases.briefing_cn:
生化人破坏季度选举的阴谋层出不穷，公民对选票能否得到有效管理的信心已严重受损。公民必须绝对信任：经算法推演认定，选举结果准确代表了他们的意志。

选举安全专家小组给出结论后，超级地球政府已通过一部全面的《超级安全选举法》。法案削减不必要的监督环节，减少参与民主管理的人员，选举流程从此远不易受到敌方干预。法案还拨出新的军费，用于维护选举安全。

绝地潜兵的军械库已获得多项战略配备增强，奉命维护选举安全——以任何必要手段。

major_order.title: MAJOR ORDER
major_order.brief: Uphold election security by destroying all those who would threaten it.
major_order.translated_brief: 维护选举安全：消灭一切胆敢威胁它的人。
